name: CA-Identity-SIN
description: SIN shape + nearby English/French label; no Luhn. Prefer Zscaler native SIN validator.

name: CA-Identity-Passports
description: Canadian passport new and legacy formats

name: CA-Identity-IRCC
description: Federal immigration and identity document number formats
expression: ((D:CA-IRCC-UCI > 0) OR (D:CA-IRCC-COPR > 0) OR (D:CA-IRCC-PR-Card > 0) OR (D:CA-IRCC-Citizenship > 0) OR (D:CA-IRCC-Landing > 0) OR (D:CA-Status-Registration > 0) OR (D:CA-Birth-Registration > 0))

name: CA-Identity-Driver
description: 13 provincial and territorial driver licence candidate formats; QA required
expression: ((D:CA-Driver-NL > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-PE > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NS > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NB > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-QC > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-ON > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-MB > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-SK > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-AB > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-BC > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-YT > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NT > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NU > 0))

name: CA-Health-Numbers
description: 13 jurisdictional provincial/territorial healthcare identifiers; context constrained
expression: ((D:CA-Health-NL > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-PE > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-NS > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-NB > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-QC > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-ON > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-MB > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-SK > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-AB > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-BC > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-YT > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-NT > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-NU > 0))

name: CA-Health-Records
description: Health ID with clinical context; Canadian PHI candidate
expression: (((D:CA-Health-NL > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-PE > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-NS > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-NB > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-QC > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-ON > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-MB > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-SK > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-AB > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-BC > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-YT > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-NT > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-NU > 0)) AND (D:CA-Clinical-Docs > 0))

name: CA-Finance-Tax
description: Federal CRA and Quebec tax/business identification

name: CA-Finance-Payroll
description: Payroll terms with SIN or CRA payroll account

name: CA-Contact-Address
description: Canadian postal code plus address labeling

name: CA-Contact-Identity
description: Contact data combination; phone number is shared with USA

name: CA-Education-Record
description: Education terminology and birth date/postal context

name: CA-PII-Composite
description: Canadian identification and composite personal data
expression: (((D:CA-SIN-Context > 0) OR (D:CA-Passport-New > 0) OR (D:CA-Passport-Legacy > 0) OR (D:CA-IRCC-UCI > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NL > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-PE > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NS > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NB > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-QC > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-ON > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-MB > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-SK > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-AB > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-BC > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-YT > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NT > 0) OR (D:CA-Driver-NU > 0)) OR ((D:CA-DOB > 0) AND (D:CA-Canada-Postal > 0)))
